archetypes.name: dyn-fixture-contract
archetypes.rationale: Implement and design session fixtures must stay on separate contracts without key bleed.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect tests/support/session.py and migrated call sites. Confirm write_session_env baseline matches the old dispatch _session keys, CODEX_PRESENT and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT stay absent by default, write_design_source_env stays on WRITE_DESIGN_ENV_KEYS with shell export format, and sparse omit+override call sites never conflict on the same key. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
